summary: Add an optional, unwired collection-v1 sidebar read adapter with exact HTTP failure classification and metadata-only invalidation.

compatibility.detail: The optional client feature adds pure HTTP page and low-level stream conversions. Hosts decode MembershipPage before generated decoding discards collection-v1 metadata and supply the epoch from the same raw stream frame. Missing epochs refuse. Paging exposes Unsupported, InvalidCursor and FrontierInconsistent terminal states; snapshot provenance uses the actual optional published_at wire timestamp rather than a nonexistent expires_at field. Default consumers do not depend on fractal-client.
